## Personality

Bertie Shakespeare is characterized by a tendency to be confused and inaccurate, being unable to ever get anything straight. Despite his notable surname, he lacks artistic talent and cannot write poetry to save his soul.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P24](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0024), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P58](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0058)_

## History

Shakespeare is a minor figure known in the context of the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary community. The local town gossip surrounding various residents, including Mr. Meredith's potential courtship of [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), is frequently discussed alongside Shakespeare's works among neighbors like [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and Miss Cornelia.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +88 more_
